description: This file defines a class 'Functions' providing static methods for complex number mathematical operations such as trigonometric, hyperbolic, inverse functions, and other complex number manipulations.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for complex number mathematical operations such as trigonometric, hyperbolic, inverse functions, and other complex number manipulations.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value (modulus) of a complex number, synonym for rho().

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: acot
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: acoth
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: acsc
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: acsch
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Returns the argument (theta) of a complex number, synonym for theta().

methods.name: asec
methods.description: Calculates the inverse secant of a complex number.

methods.name: asech
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic secant of a complex number.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Calculates the inverse sine of a complex number.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Calculates the inverse tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: conjugate
